scope: EX716 practical integer C subset: 16-bit int, 32-bit long, 16-bit DS near pointers; C90-derived syntax with selected C99 library extensions. Not an ISO conformance suite.

features.title: EX716 integer and pointer model
acceptance: Assert byte/short/int/long/pointer widths and signed plain char; public limits must agree.
features.source: int main(void){return sizeof(char)!=1 || sizeof(short)!=2 || sizeof(int)!=2 || sizeof(long)!=4 || sizeof(void*)!=2 || (char)-1>=0;}

features.title: Existing mixed-width calls
acceptance: Existing regression must pass; verify frame restoration and empty hardware stack in all three modes.

features.title: Existing integer math
acceptance: Existing regression must pass; verify frame restoration and empty hardware stack in all three modes.

features.title: Existing local arrays
acceptance: Existing regression must pass; verify frame restoration and empty hardware stack in all three modes.

features.title: Existing aggregate return
acceptance: Existing regression must pass; verify frame restoration and empty hardware stack in all three modes.

features.title: Unsigned comparisons across sign bit
acceptance: Exercise all six comparisons at 0,32767,32768,65535, with both operand orders.
features.source: int main(void){unsigned int a,b; a=65535U;b=32768U; if(a<=b||a<b||b>=a||b>a)return 1; if(!(a>0U)||!(0U<a))return 2; return 0;}

features.title: Signed comparisons at both extremes
acceptance: Exercise all signed comparisons without relying on signed overflow.

features.title: Integer conversions and promotions
acceptance: 8-to-16 sign/zero extension,16-to-32,32-to-16, mixed signed/unsigned promotions.
features.source: int main(void){signed char a; unsigned char b; int i; long l; a=-128;b=255;i=-123;l=i; if(l!=-123L||a!=-128||b!=255)return 1; l=65535L;i=(int)l;if(i!=-1)return 2;return 0;}

features.title: Signed quotient and remainder
acceptance: Use positive/negative dividends/divisors; quotient/remainder identity; excludes division by zero and signed-min / -1.

features.title: Long comparisons across word boundaries
acceptance: Signed and unsigned 32-bit EQ/NE/LT/LE/GT/GE, equal low words and different high words.

features.title: Short-circuit side effects
acceptance: RHS runs exactly when required; skipped RHS must not change state.

features.title: Loop and jump control flow
acceptance: for/while/do,break,continue,goto,early return, nested branches.

features.title: Sparse switch
acceptance: Cases/default, negative labels, fall-through and nested break.

features.title: Dense switch and jump-table lowering
acceptance: Dense switch dispatch returns the selected case result; signed selectors below and above the table range select default.

features.title: Recursive frame lifetime
acceptance: Local addresses remain valid across calls; bounded recursion restores software stack.
features.source: int sum(int n){int saved;int *p;saved=n;p=&saved;if(n==0)return 0;return sum(n-1)+*p;}int main(void){return sum(6)!=21;}

features.title: Local-name shadowing
acceptance: Nested and sibling blocks with identical names must have distinct storage/aliases.
features.source: int main(void){int x,y;x=1;y=0;{int x;x=2;y=x;}{int x;x=3;if(x!=3)return 2;}return x!=1||y!=2;}

features.title: Adjacent byte stores
acceptance: Odd/even byte stores preserve neighbors; add segment-end byte case separately.

features.title: Pointer difference and scaling
acceptance: Positive/negative ptrdiff within same object, byte/int/long element strides.
features.source: int char_diff(void){char a[5];char *p,*q;p=a+4;q=a+1;return p-q!=3||q-p!=-3;}int long_diff(void){long a[5];long *p,*q;p=a+4;q=a+1;return p-q!=3||q-p!=-3;}int assigned_diff(void){int a[5];int *p,*q;long d;p=a+1;q=a+4;d=p-q;return d!=-3L;}int main(void){int a[5];int *p,*q;p=a+4;q=a+1;return p-q!=3||q-p!=-3||!(q<p)||char_diff()||long_diff()||assigned_diff();}

features.title: Local initialized array
acceptance: Automatic aggregate initializers, partial zero fill, and string-initialized char arrays.

features.title: Global initialized data
acceptance: Emit writable scalar, array, struct, and string objects in DS; preserve initial values, layout, address-of and later writes.
features.source: struct R{char c;int n;};int g=7;unsigned char b=255;long wide=-123456L;int values[3]={2,4,6};struct R record={'A',0x1234};char message[]="x\n";int main(void){if(g!=7||b!=255||wide!=-123456L||values[0]!=2||values[1]!=4||values[2]!=6||record.c!='A'||record.n!=0x1234||message[0]!='x'||message[1]!=10||message[2]!=0)return 1;g=9;b=1;wide=100000L;return g!=9||b!=1||wide!=100000L;}

features.title: Global zero-initialized storage
acceptance: Tentative definitions/zeroed BSS, arrays, pointers and aggregate layout.
features.source: struct S{char c;int i;};int g;int a[3];int *p;struct S s;int main(void){if(g||a[0]||a[1]||a[2]||p||s.c||s.i)return 1;p=a;a[2]=9;s.c=0x34;s.i=0x1234;return (g?1:0)|(p[2]!=9?2:0)|(s.c!=0x34?4:0)|(s.i!=0x1234?8:0);}

features.title: Static local persistence
acceptance: Initialized static locals persist across calls and distinct same-spelling statics do not alias.
features.source: int next(void){static int n=5;n++;return n;}int other(void){static int n=2;n+=2;return n;}int main(void){return next()!=6||other()!=4||next()!=7||other()!=6;}

features.title: String literals in DS
acceptance: NUL terminator, escapes, distinct literals; DS access with CS != DS.

features.title: Global address initializer
acceptance: Relocations for object/function addresses and object-plus-offset.

features.title: Indirect function call
acceptance: Runtime-selected near function addresses, indirect calls, callback arguments/results, mixed-width fixed calls, variadic calls, and stack cleanup.

features.title: Variadic caller stack discipline
acceptance: Extra arguments use the caller-owned packet; empty packets and fixed calls retain correct stack/result behavior.
features.source: int f(int n,...){return n;}int fixed(int n){return n+1;}int main(void){return f(7,11,123456L)!=7||f(5)!=5||fixed(3)!=4;}

features.title: Public stdarg mixed-width traversal
acceptance: va_start/va_arg/va_end, promoted narrow values, mixed widths, pointers, nested variadic calls and cursor advancement.
features.source:
#include <stdarg.h>
long f(int n,...){va_list ap;int a,b;long c;va_start(ap,n);a=va_arg(ap,int);b=va_arg(ap,int);c=va_arg(ap,long);va_end(ap);return a+b+c;}long outer(int n,...){va_list ap;long x;va_start(ap,n);x=va_arg(ap,long);va_end(ap);return n+x;}char *pick(int n,...){va_list ap;char *p;va_start(ap,n);p=va_arg(ap,char *);va_end(ap);return p;}int mixed_test(void){return f(3,(char)7,11,100000L)!=100018L;}int nested_test(void){return outer(1,f(3,9,0,100000L))!=100010L;}int pointer_test(void){return pick(1,"ok")[1]!='k';}int main(void){return mixed_test()+2*nested_test()+4*pointer_test();}

features.title: Function frame above 40 bytes
acceptance: At least a 64-byte automatic buffer; configurable bounded stack; diagnostic rather than corrupt frame.

features.title: Small aggregate copy (2 bytes)
acceptance: Exact block copies of 1, 2, and 3 bytes; block assignment must not be confused with scalar value load.
features.source: struct A{char x;};struct B{char x,y;};struct C{char x,y,z;};int main(void){struct A a,b;struct B c,d;struct C e,f;a.x=7;b=a;c.x=8;c.y=9;d=c;e.x=10;e.y=11;e.z=12;f=e;return b.x!=7||d.x!=8||d.y!=9||f.x!=10||f.y!=11||f.z!=12;}

features.title: Small aggregate copy (4 bytes)
acceptance: Copy exact four bytes and preserve surrounding fields.
features.source: struct S{int x,y;};int main(void){struct S a,b;a.x=7;a.y=9;b=a;return b.x!=7||b.y!=9;}

features.title: Union and bit-fields
acceptance: Union layout and read/modify/write bit-fields; add signed fields and packing boundaries.
features.source: union U{unsigned int w;unsigned char b[2];};struct B{unsigned int a:3;unsigned int b:5;};int main(void){union U u;struct B f;u.w=0x1234;f.a=5;f.b=17;return u.b[0]!=0x34||u.b[1]!=0x12||f.a!=5||f.b!=17;}

features.title: Multiple translation units
acceptance: Compile units separately and combine assembly without duplicate private labels; external function resolves.

features.title: Internal-linkage function names
acceptance: Two units may each define same-named static functions and data with different behavior; emitted functions, branch labels, data, and constants must be unique.
units: static int value=3;static char text[]="A";static int f(int x){if(x)return value+text[0];return 0;}int other(void);int main(void){return f(1)!=68||f(0)!=0||other()!=71;}
static int value=5;static char text[]="B";static int f(int x){if(x)return value+text[0];return 0;}int other(void){return f(1);}

features.title: Floating-point operations
acceptance: Conversions, arithmetic and comparisons must preserve declared float/double semantics; fail loudly until supported.

features.title: Float must not silently use integer arithmetic
acceptance: Float is four bytes but ADD/F and ADD/I require different code; reject unsupported float with nonzero compiler exit.
features.source: int main(void){float a,b;a=1.5f;b=2.25f;return a==b || a+b!=3.75f || a+b==4.0f;}

features.title: Indirect-call lowering remains safely supported
acceptance: The former unsupported indirect-call path executes with correct results and balanced stacks.

features.title: Unsupported floating-point expression fails compilation
acceptance: Valid float arithmetic receives an EX716 backend diagnostic and nonzero compiler exit; it must not be silently lowered as integer arithmetic.

features.title: Small aggregate copy remains safely supported
acceptance: A valid two-byte struct assignment executes correctly after the former unsupported path became implemented.
features.source: struct S{int x;};int main(void){struct S a,b;a.x=7;b=a;return b.x!=7;}

features.title: Dense switch hole and default dispatch
acceptance: A dense jump table maps a missing in-range selector and signed out-of-range selectors to default.

features.title: Front-end invalid source diagnostic
acceptance: Nonzero compiler exit for invalid C; never assemble rejected translation.

int main(void){return TWICE(3)!=6;}

features.title: 64-bit integer execution
acceptance: long long arithmetic/conversions/calls require eight-byte values; until available, issue a nonzero diagnostic.

features.title: Application startup and shutdown
acceptance: Initialize zero storage, DS, stack and optional heap; main(void) and defined argv contract; exit status, fflush/atexit cleanup.

features.title: Public build/assemble workflow
acceptance: One reproducible target-only cpp/rcc/runtime command; multiple units and internal symbols; tool errors propagate.
features.reason: Audit assembles test harnesses; no EX716-configured production lcc driver located.

features.title: Stack and segment bounds
acceptance: Frame reservation checks bottom before writing; valid near-pointer segment model; exhaustion diagnosed; no CS/DS/heap/stack overlap.
features.reason: Full segment-end and code/data/heap/stack overlap vectors remain unimplemented.

features.title: Software-stack frame exhaustion
acceptance: A recursive C frame that exceeds the configured software stack reports stack exhaustion before writing below the stack bottom.
features.source: int descend(int n){unsigned char frame[240];frame[0]=(unsigned char)n;if(n==0)return frame[0];return descend(n-1)+frame[0];}int main(void){return descend(30);}
features.diagnostic: Error. Code Stack Out of Bounds

features.title: Configurable C software-stack size
acceptance: The target stack-size option increases the available C recursion depth beyond the default 4 KiB stack.
